version_tag: #146 CARRIER + FIXTURE v17 rev E — SINGLE COLOUR. *** THE TWO CARRIER ARMS RON RECOVERED FROM THE STOPPED rev B RUN ARE SCRAP — REPRINT THEM, do not reuse. *** He spotted it on the bench: the pivot pad overhangs the arm's own press-fit bore. Measured from the file, a full-circle r3.50 pad at a 4.81mm station spacing against a r2.60 bore covers 1.29mm of the 5.20mm bore mouth across 120 deg of its rim. Two ways that bites: the lip prints unsupported over the hole and droops exactly where the satellite bears, and if the post below comes out even slightly long it fouls the lip and the arm never seats. The pad is now CLIPPED clear of the bore with 0.30 clearance, keeping 296 of 360 deg of thrust contact at the satellite's bore edge. Every gate we had compared one PART against another; this was one part, two features, so all of them were blind to it. assembly_gate_v17 now has a within-part feature check. Rest of the plate unchanged from rev D: 148_fixture_r62_v17 (K4 key 18.0 -> 25.0; REPLACES 49_fixture_r61 in the machine) and 147_sun_spacer (OD r5.30). 4 parts, flat, no supports, xy-comp -0.06. | QUIET.
